description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Ex-Azure Dragoon Mode I (Estinien)] and [Dragoon Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Ex-Azure Dragoon Mode I (Estinien)
description.text: Dragoon abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dragoon abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and 50%/75%/100% critical chance for equipped Dragoon abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Dragoon abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Ex-Azure Dragoon Mode II (Estinien)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Ex-Azure Dragoon Mode II (Estinien)
description.text: Cast speed x999999 for Dragoon abilities, chases Dragoon abilities with Longan Power

description.name: Longan Power
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)] and grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)]/[ATK and MAG +30%, DEF and RES +25% (8s)] if 0-3/4+ FF14 allies are alive

description.name: Imperil Prismatic 20% (15s)
